newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt buys 3,500 tonnes of RSS3 rubber.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt buys 3,500 tonnes of RSS3 rubber.

text.p: The Thai government entered the market again this week and bought 3,500 tonnes of RSS3 rubber at 110.00 US cents per kg for July shipment, a source at the rubber auction market in southern Hat Yai said on Tuesday.
The source said the government looked set to buy aggressively over the next few weeks to help prop up prices.

The government also sought 2,000 tonnes of RSS4 grade but was still negotiating as sellers offered prices in the range of 108.00-120.00 US cents per kg which was seen as too high by the government, the source added.
"For the RSS3 grade, the government originally bid to buy 5,000 tonnes. But it actually bought 3,500 tonnes as a limited amount of sellers were willing to sell at 110," the source said.
